title: Ownership Transfer
prompt: Implement `make_counter()` returning `std::unique_ptr<int>` holding 0, and `take_and_bump(std::unique_ptr<int> p)` that increments the value and RETURNS the same pointer onward.

tests.name: bump
tests.hint: Ownership moves in and straight back out; the value is incremented.

tests.name: source emptied
tests.code: auto p = make_counter(); auto q = take_and_bump(std::move(p)); CHECK(p == nullptr);
tests.hint: After the move, the source unique_ptr is null — ownership moved.
